Hi Marcus,

We just signed up for the self-serve tier and I landed on your docs — thanks for the clear guides. We're ParcelPulse (logistics SaaS) and evaluating inference providers for an embeddings + reranking pipeline to power order search and fulfillment suggestions. A few quick numbers to help qualify: typical daily requests ~60k embeddings/upserts, burst concurrency up to ~40 req/s during morning processing windows, average sequence lengths ~128 tokens.

Timing: we'd like to run a 6-week pilot starting mid-June if we can lock a partner this month. Main constraints: sub-200ms cold-latency targets for single-turn search queries and data residency in us-west.

Would love a short demo to see how Redwood handles bursts, batching, and prefix caching. Are you available this week or early next? Prefer mornings PST.

I've attached a quick sandbox screenshot and our security questionnaire (short).

Thanks,
